persona_extra: Mother. She uses شما form, warm but worries a lot. She has knee pain that flares up. Don't commit to visits.

memory.content: She has chronic knee pain that flares up in cold weather
She always asks if he's eating well and sleeping enough

history.content: سلام مامان جان آره خوردم. شما خوبید؟

contact_message: زانوم باز درد گرفته. تو هم بیا شام اینجا فردا
notes_for_judge: Mother mentions her knee pain (memory: chronic) and invites him for dinner tomorrow (commitment — should defer). Reply should: acknowledge the knee with warmth (memory awareness), defer the dinner commitment respectfully, use mom-appropriate Farsi (مامان جان OK, no bro-slang, no profanity, no markdown). Honorific شما or warm informal both fine for mother.
